prompt.alinti: Run a full desktop on your phone, no computer needed.
It's called Dextop, an open-source Android app that creates a virtual display and turns your phone into a desktop workspace.
Come at desktop, and I'll send you the repo link.

yontem.ne: Android cihazı bir masaüstü çalışma alanına dönüştürme uygulaması
yontem.alinti: Dextop is an open-source Android app that creates a virtual display and provides a control app launching.windowplacement,touchinput,orientation,andrelated desktop behavior.

akis.ne: Uygulama başlatıcıyı kullanma ve çalışma alanlarını kaydetme
akis.alinti: You get a launcher for your apps and workspaces that save and restore where each app was placed

akis.ne: Birden fazla uygulamayı yan yana çalıştırma
akis.alinti: You can run two, three, or four apps side-by-side and use a physical mouse and keyboard.

yazi: GitHub: NarYuki/Dextop, Lisans: GPL-3.0, Özellikler: Virtual displays with configurable resolution.density, and portrait or landscape orientation, Workspace import and export as JSON, Physical keyboard support, Mouse and keyboard input routing.
